name: Jangalpara

registryBasis: The official Hooghly health directory identifies Jangalpara as a local place and West Bengal publishes land-record services. A separate primary DILRMP report verifies historical 2018 records for Jangipara tehsil. The different spelling and unbound settlement footprint do not independently establish a Jangalpara-specific registry custodian. Presence remains unestablished, not absent.
scopeLimits: Research uses official public sources and preserves the exact unchanged WUP locator. No owner, address, account, tax, personal-property, credential or token data requested or retained. No citywide completeness asserted.
remainingUncertainty: The WUP locator is a population-weighted settlement point, not a mouza/plot identity; exact local mouza and map-sheet coverage were not matched. No anonymous geometry was verified.

officialSources.observation: The official Hooghly district health directory lists Jangalpara PHC, tying the locality to Hooghly. West Bengal’s official Banglarbhumi portal provides plot/RoR and plot/mouza-map services; its interface requires login for citizen map requests, and the official UDMA Know Your Property procedure requires OTP registration and block/mouza/plot selection. No anonymous parcel geometry service was identified.
